title: Verify dependency recovery and publication
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. Recovery requires both correct data and current execution/checkpoint evidence. Return latest visible Source/Target differing FULL JOIN rows, duplicated Target key groups, one per non-SUCCESS activity, and one if the latest step is absent/non-SUCCESS or its batch checkpoint differs from context. An older failed run remains evidence after RECOVER; inspect the latest step, not any historical failure. A partial publication can report SUCCESS and still miss a key. Repeat recovery must retain one row per order.
learning_objectives: Separate execution, quality and incomplete evidence.
